title: The latest signal

items.title: Quantum tomography of fermion pairs in e + e − collisions: Longitudinal beam polarization effects
items.why_it_matters: We present a quantum tomography study of fermion pair production at future $e^+e^-$ colliders, emphasizing how longitudinal beam polarization controls the two-qubit spin density matrix. We study the processes $e^+ e^- \to t\bar{t},\ e^+e^-\to μ^+μ^-$ and Bhabha scattering $e^+e^-\to e^+e^-$, representing the mass threshold behavior, the $Z$ pole resonance and the $s/t$-channel interplay.

items.title: Effects of auditory sensory stimulation on consciousness and physiological parameters among individuals with disorders of consciousness: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.why_it_matters: Objective To systematically evaluate the effects of auditory sensory stimulation (SS) on consciousness levels and physiological parameters in patients with disorders of consciousness (DOC). Furthermore, this study aimed to explore intervention characteristics based on the frequency, intensity, time, and type (FITT) framework that may influence treatment effects and to investigate potential sources of between-study heterogeneity.

items.title: Evaluation of Quantum Machine Learning Models for Network Anomaly Detection
items.why_it_matters: The proliferation of Internet-connected devices has intensified the risk of large-scale network intrusions, necessitating more advanced detection methodologies for the post quantum era. This work presents, to the best of our knowledge, a com- prehensive investigation of quantum machine learning (QML) for anomaly detection on the BoT-IoT dataset, a widely adopted benchmark for IoT security.
